_description: Prior for the analysis (Sec. 4). Public-data fits of all five simulations (FIRE: SFR over 100 Myr from star particles), pooled; widths widened only where justified: sigma_SHMR (simulations agree more tightly than their shared physics warrants), f_*,0 (degenerate with sigma_SHMR in the UV LF), t_* (simulations report SFRs on different timescales). sigma_SFMS,0 and the rest keep the pooled simulation spread; no global inflation. M_knee fixed at 2e12 Msun.

combine._note: variance_scale = 1, so the variances below are the effective prior variances (sd 1.549, 0.600, 0.2135: the widths used so far).
